meanings.en: fond of or given to talking a lot
meanings.exampleEn: My sister is very talkative and can chat for hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Kız kardeşim çok konuşkandır ve saatlerce sohbet edebilir.

meanings.en: a large container for holding liquid or gas
meanings.exampleEn: The water tank on the roof was almost empty.
meanings.exampleTr: Çatıdaki su deposu neredeyse boştu.

meanings.en: the flavour of something in the mouth
meanings.exampleEn: This soup has a strong taste of garlic.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu çorbanın güçlü bir sarımsak tadı var.

meanings.en: having little or no flavour
meanings.exampleEn: The vegetables were overcooked and completely tasteless.
meanings.exampleTr: Sebzeler fazla pişmişti ve tamamen tatsızdı.

meanings.en: having a pleasant flavour
meanings.exampleEn: She cooked a tasty meal for the whole family.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün aile için lezzetli bir yemek pişirdi.

meanings.en: money paid to the government on income or goods
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone has to pay income tax on their earnings.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkes kazancı üzerinden gelir vergisi ödemek zorundadır.

meanings.en: the work or profession of educating people
meanings.exampleEn: She has spent twenty years in teaching.
meanings.exampleTr: Yirmi yılını öğretmenlikte geçirdi.

meanings.en: a fellow member of a team
meanings.exampleEn: He passed the ball to his teammate near the goal.
meanings.exampleTr: Topu kale yakınındaki takım arkadaşına pasladı.

meanings.en: the combined effort of a group working together
meanings.exampleEn: Good teamwork helped them win the project.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi takım çalışması projeyi kazanmalarına yardımcı oldu.

meanings.en: a person who playfully makes fun of others
meanings.exampleEn: My brother is such a tease that he never stops joking.
meanings.exampleTr: Kardeşim öyle bir şakacıdır ki hiç şaka yapmaktan vazgeçmez.

meanings.en: a particular way of doing something skilfully
meanings.exampleEn: The artist developed a new painting technique.
meanings.exampleTr: Sanatçı yeni bir resim tekniği geliştirdi.

meanings.en: relating to technology or its development

meanings.exampleTr: Teknolojik gelişmeler çalışma şeklimizi değiştirdi.

meanings.en: a person aged between thirteen and nineteen
meanings.exampleEn: The film is very popular among teens.
meanings.exampleTr: Film gençler arasında çok popüler.

meanings.en: communication over long distances by phone or internet
meanings.exampleEn: He works for a large telecommunications company.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük bir telekomünikasyon şirketinde çalışıyor.

meanings.en: a message sent by telegraph and delivered in writing
meanings.exampleEn: They sent a telegram to announce the good news.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi haberi duyurmak için bir telgraf çektiler.

meanings.en: a person who handles money in a bank
meanings.exampleEn: The bank teller counted the cash carefully.
meanings.exampleTr: Banka veznedarı parayı dikkatlice saydı.

meanings.en: a tendency to become angry easily
meanings.exampleEn: He has a bad temper and shouts when he is upset.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötü bir huyu var ve sinirlendiğinde bağırır.

meanings.en: lasting for only a limited time
meanings.exampleEn: She took a temporary job during the summer.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaz boyunca geçici bir iş buldu.

meanings.en: to make someone want to do or have something
meanings.exampleEn: The smell of fresh bread tempted me to buy a loaf.
meanings.exampleTr: Taze ekmeğin kokusu beni bir somun almaya cezbetti.

meanings.en: to be likely to do or behave in a certain way
meanings.exampleEn: People tend to spend more money during holidays.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsanlar tatil sırasında daha fazla para harcama eğilimindedir.

meanings.en: an inclination to behave in a particular way
meanings.exampleEn: He has a tendency to arrive late for meetings.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantılara geç gelme eğilimi var.

meanings.en: nervous, anxious, or unable to relax
meanings.exampleEn: She felt tense before the important interview.
meanings.exampleTr: Önemli görüşmeden önce gergin hissetti.

meanings.en: a state of mental or emotional strain
meanings.exampleEn: There was a lot of tension between the two teams.
meanings.exampleTr: İki takım arasında çok fazla gerginlik vardı.

meanings.en: a portable shelter made of cloth, used for camping
meanings.exampleEn: We put up our tent near the river.
meanings.exampleTr: Çadırımızı nehrin yakınına kurduk.

meanings.en: a fixed period of time, especially at school
meanings.exampleEn: The exams take place at the end of each term.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınavlar her dönemin sonunda yapılır.

meanings.en: a building where journeys begin or end
meanings.exampleEn: We waited at the bus terminal for an hour.
meanings.exampleTr: Otobüs terminalinde bir saat bekledik.

meanings.en: very much or extremely

meanings.exampleTr: Geç kaldığım için çok özür dilerim.

meanings.en: extremely good or impressive
meanings.exampleEn: You did a terrific job on the presentation.
meanings.exampleTr: Sunumda harika bir iş çıkardın.

meanings.en: extremely frightened
meanings.exampleEn: She was terrified of the loud thunder.
meanings.exampleTr: Gürültülü gök gürültüsünden çok korkmuştu.

meanings.en: extreme fear
meanings.exampleEn: The children screamed in terror during the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar fırtına sırasında dehşet içinde çığlık attı.

meanings.en: the use of violence to achieve political aims
meanings.exampleEn: The government introduced new laws to fight terrorism.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet terörizmle mücadele için yeni yasalar çıkardı.

meanings.en: pleased and grateful for something
meanings.exampleEn: I am thankful for all the help you gave me.
meanings.exampleTr: Bana verdiğin tüm yardım için minnettarım.

meanings.en: the act of stealing something
meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for the theft of a car.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir araba hırsızlığından dolayı tutuklandı.

meanings.en: an idea or set of ideas used to explain something
meanings.exampleEn: Scientists tested the theory with many experiments.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları teoriyi birçok deneyle test etti.

meanings.en: complete and careful in every detail
meanings.exampleEn: The police carried out a thorough investigation.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis ayrıntılı bir soruşturma yürüttü.

meanings.en: a statement or sign of intended harm
meanings.exampleEn: Pollution is a serious threat to the environment.
meanings.exampleTr: Kirlilik çevre için ciddi bir tehdittir.

meanings.en: expressing an intention to cause harm
meanings.exampleEn: He sent a threatening letter to his neighbour.
meanings.exampleTr: Komşusuna tehdit edici bir mektup gönderdi.

meanings.en: an exciting story or film full of suspense
meanings.exampleEn: We watched a thriller that kept us on the edge of our seats.
meanings.exampleTr: Bizi koltuğun ucuna oturtan bir gerilim filmi izledik.

meanings.en: from one end or side to the other
meanings.exampleEn: Please read the whole document through before signing.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen imzalamadan önce tüm belgeyi baştan sona okuyun.

meanings.en: the short thick finger on the side of the hand
meanings.exampleEn: She cut her thumb while slicing bread.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekmek keserken başparmağını kesti.

meanings.en: to hit something heavily, making a dull sound
meanings.exampleEn: He thumped the table angrily with his fist.
meanings.exampleTr: Yumruğuyla masaya öfkeyle vurdu.

meanings.en: the loud noise that follows lightning in a storm
meanings.exampleEn: The thunder woke the children in the night.
meanings.exampleTr: Gök gürültüsü gece çocukları uyandırdı.

meanings.en: extremely loud, like thunder
meanings.exampleEn: The audience gave a thunderous round of applause.
meanings.exampleTr: Seyirci gürül gürül alkışladı.

meanings.en: as a result or consequence of this
meanings.exampleEn: He missed the train and thus arrived late.
meanings.exampleTr: Treni kaçırdı ve böylece geç geldi.

meanings.en: a mark used to show something is correct
meanings.exampleEn: Put a tick next to each correct answer.
meanings.exampleTr: Her doğru cevabın yanına bir onay işareti koyun.

meanings.en: the regular rise and fall of the sea
meanings.exampleEn: The boat was carried out to sea by the tide.
meanings.exampleTr: Tekne gelgit tarafından açık denize sürüklendi.

meanings.en: to make something firmer or more secure
meanings.exampleEn: He tightened the screws on the shelf.
meanings.exampleTr: Raftaki vidaları sıktı.

meanings.en: in a firm or secure manner
meanings.exampleEn: She held the rope tightly so it would not slip.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaymasın diye ipi sıkıca tuttu.

meanings.en: a flat piece used to cover roofs, floors or walls
meanings.exampleEn: They laid new tiles on the bathroom floor.
meanings.exampleTr: Banyo zeminine yeni fayanslar döşediler.

meanings.en: happening at a suitable or useful moment
meanings.exampleEn: Her timely warning helped us avoid the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun zamanında uyarısı kazadan kaçınmamıza yardımcı oldu.

meanings.en: a metal container for storing food
meanings.exampleEn: She opened a tin of beans for dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşam yemeği için bir teneke kutu fasulye açtı.

meanings.en: extremely small
meanings.exampleEn: A tiny insect crawled across the page.
meanings.exampleTr: Minicik bir böcek sayfanın üzerinde sürünüyordu.

meanings.en: to become or make weary
meanings.exampleEn: Long walks tire the elderly dog quickly.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüşler yaşlı köpeği çabucak yorar.

meanings.en: making you feel tired
meanings.exampleEn: It was a long and tiring journey home.
meanings.exampleTr: Eve dönüş uzun ve yorucu bir yolculuktu.

meanings.en: a soft piece of paper used for wiping the nose
meanings.exampleEn: She took a tissue to wipe away her tears.
meanings.exampleTr: Gözyaşlarını silmek için bir kağıt mendil aldı.

meanings.en: the dried leaves used in cigarettes

meanings.en: the soft movable organ in the mouth used for tasting and speaking

meanings.en: a paste used for cleaning the teeth

meanings.exampleTr: Fırçana biraz diş macunu koy.

meanings.en: highest in position, rank or quality
meanings.exampleEn: She got the top mark in the whole class.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm sınıfta en yüksek notu aldı.

meanings.en: a violent rotating column of wind
meanings.exampleEn: The tornado destroyed several houses in the town.
meanings.exampleTr: Hortum kasabadaki birkaç evi yıktı.

meanings.en: to throw something lightly or carelessly
meanings.exampleEn: He tossed the keys onto the table.
meanings.exampleTr: Anahtarları masanın üzerine fırlattı.

meanings.en: complete, including everything
meanings.exampleEn: The total cost of the trip was very high.
meanings.exampleTr: Gezinin toplam maliyeti çok yüksekti.

meanings.en: completely or absolutely

meanings.exampleTr: Kararına tamamen katılıyorum.

meanings.en: the business of providing services for travellers
meanings.exampleEn: Tourism is very important for the local economy.
meanings.exampleTr: Turizm yerel ekonomi için çok önemlidir.

meanings.en: a competition with many players or teams
meanings.exampleEn: Our school won the chess tournament this year.
meanings.exampleTr: Okulumuz bu yıl satranç turnuvasını kazandı.

meanings.en: a small sign that something existed
meanings.exampleEn: The police found no trace of the missing man.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis kayıp adamdan hiçbir iz bulamadı.

meanings.en: a loose warm outfit worn for sport
meanings.exampleEn: He wore a tracksuit to the morning training.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabah antrenmanına eşofman giydi.

meanings.en: according to long-established customs
meanings.exampleEn: Traditionally, families gather together for the holiday.
meanings.exampleTr: Geleneksel olarak, aileler bayram için bir araya gelir.

meanings.en: a long line of vehicles unable to move freely
meanings.exampleEn: We were stuck in a traffic jam for two hours.
meanings.exampleTr: İki saat boyunca trafik sıkışıklığında kaldık.

meanings.en: a very sad event causing great suffering

meanings.exampleTr: Kaza tüm kasaba için korkunç bir trajediydi.
